in_marathi.name: Veerangana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Veerangana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Veerangana is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'veera' (brave) and 'angana' (Goddess). It is believed to be the name of a brave warrior goddess. In Hindu mythology, Veerangana is often depicted as a fierce and powerful deity, who protects her devotees from harm.
